name: Verify complete homepage inline graph
on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/doi-23474664-preserve-inline]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with: {persist-credentials: false}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: {node-version-file: .nvmrc, cache: npm}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: {python-version: '3.12'}
      - name: Install build and validation dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          python -m pip install requests 'pyarrow>=18,<23' 'kaggle==2.2.4' 'rdflib>=7,<8' 'pyshacl>=0.30,<1' 'mlcroissant==1.1.1' 'PyLD>=2,<4' PyYAML
      - name: Validate complete source and built representations
        run: |
          node --test tests/*.test.mjs
          npm run build
          python tests/coordinated-doi-release.test.py
          python tests/doi-validation.test.py
          python tests/platform-bundle-sync.test.py
          python tests/platform-publication.test.py
          python tests/validate_machine_resources.py dist
          python tests/validate_canonical_invariants.py dist
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          sys.path.insert(0,'.github/scripts')
          from browser_projection import validate_home_projection
          from doi_validation import validate_policy
          from html.parser import HTMLParser
          class Inline(HTMLParser):
              def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.capture=False;self.text=[];self.blocks=[]
              def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
                  if tag=='script' and dict(attrs).get('type')=='application/ld+json':self.capture=True;self.text=[]
              def handle_data(self,text):
                  if self.capture:self.text.append(text)
              def handle_endtag(self,tag):
                  if tag=='script' and self.capture:self.blocks.append(json.loads(''.join(self.text)));self.capture=False
          root=Path('dist');body=(root/'index.html').read_bytes();inline=Inline();inline.feed(body.decode())
          report=validate_home_projection(root/'graph.jsonld',inline.blocks,body)
          report['htmlSha256']=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
          report['graphSha256']=hashlib.sha256((root/'graph.jsonld').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          report['doiPolicy']=validate_policy(root)
          Path('inline-preservation-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
          print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
          PY
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: complete-home-inline-evidence
          path: |
            inline-preservation-report.json
            dist/index.html
            dist/graph.jsonld
            dist/release-provenance.json
